This practical course is for all diploma students of the Technical College.
It builds the digital skills that everyone needs for study, work and daily
life: using devices and cloud services safely and responsibly, creating professional digital content, analysing data with
spreadsheets, organising data in a relational database, building and
publishing a simple website, and planning the digital marketing of a product.
The course follows the European Digital Competence Framework (DigComp 2.2).

**Textbook.** Evans, A., Martin, K. and Poatsy, M. A. *Technology in Action*,
Global Edition, 18th ed., Pearson, 2024. References: Chaffey and
Ellis-Chadwick, *Digital Marketing*, 8th ed., 2022; Duckett, *HTML and CSS*,
2011; European Commission (JRC), *DigComp 2.2*, 2022.

**How to study each lesson.** Read the lesson notes (PDF) before and after the
lab session. Use the interactive lesson page to practise: it has questions with
instant feedback and the lab tasks. The slides are a short summary for revision.

## Schedule

Two lab sessions a week, 60 minutes each, in the computer lab. Faded lessons are not available yet.
